contract: LIST channels live first and diff against this registry — a channel you do not know about is the miss that already happened once.
READ each source since the board's last_swept_at, never since 'this morning'.
DIFF findings against existing board item ids — refresh by id, never create a duplicate card.
READ TONE, not just imperatives: a worry, a passing decision, a one-off number, 'it's already done' (which CLOSES a card), an unanswered question, a verbal authorisation that will hit payroll later.
WRITE a briefing JSON and load it with pm_ingest.py — it rejects any chase card that ships no ready-to-send draft.
The sweep stamp comes from the briefing's `sweep` block; mark_swept refuses it without per-source evidence.
